Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Freeze NFRD Baseball observation/derivation/unknown input provenance, hashes, source/recall clocks and participant partitions before the proposition-to-recall pilot. Keep survey free text excluded and private bytes outside Git.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: later. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Outside the current preview path; preserve evidence and acceptance scope, resume only for a named consumer or demonstrated blocking defect.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

CODEX ACTION AFTER THE CHIEF RULING. I am treating the decision as authorization to move from inventory to a bounded NFRD Baseball intake, while keeping data acquisition independent of the proposition-provider critical path.

The work should be split at the scientific boundary:

1. INTAKE COURT INPUTS NOW. Build an NFRD-specific, local-only Baseball bundle that verifies the pinned source, transcript, and TextGrid hashes; records every field as Observation, Derivation, or Unknown; preserves the source-recall ID linkage; excludes survey free text; and freezes participant partitions before any model tuning. Source and participant bytes remain outside git. The loader must fail closed on a checksum, identity, or lineage mismatch. Its output is an auditable input bundle, not a scientific result.

2. DIAGNOSTIC COURT AFTER THE REAL EXTRACTION PATH EXISTS. The first source-to-recall number remains dependent on the new real proposition-provider bead and the separately licensed trajectory path. It will answer one declared Baseball question with support and a held-out participant court. It will be labelled Diagnostic, not calibration or validation. I will not hide those dependencies by hand-authoring a Baseball narrative graph.

Sherlock remains the later recall-side cleanup sensitivity control; gptkz remains contingent only on authenticated OSF access. The existing generic admitted-story-loader bead is a seam to reconcile, not a reason to design a corpus framework ahead of the NFRD case. I am promoting this bounded intake slice to a P1 bead and will bring the concrete API back for chief review before landing it.
